Limitations: All login revision files plus its three tool changes are held as one still-changing coupled package. A stable subset of static PNG bytes is not asserted to be a stable complete login delivery.

The observed static art has explicit existing-source hashes and no-new-AI metadata; model/quality of historical original remain unknown. Restoration here refers to in-place existing approved art, not recovery from old Git or deleted directories. No restoration script executed.

The new source includes a dynamic server-paper patch and native crops. This review checked recorded provenance/hash links only; it did not independently test pixel equality, alpha edges, layout, readability or native rendering.

Capture manifest and source differ. LoginUtilities, code manifest and installation receipt changed after the captured candidates. Any matching code-manifest hashes observed at this bounded read do not validate the earlier frozen candidate set or justify refreezing concurrent work. No repeated chase was performed.
Current client hash matches show observed adoption at the read time only. An install receipt is not a compile, Unity, rendering or live-server pass.
Shared run-ui-tests.ps1 adds the new login fixture and remains held with it; existing uploaded runner is left unchanged.

Before a later migration batch, use new complete coherent manifests and explicit current-source/verification evidence. Retain earlier Azure history, original sources and in-progress files; no deletion or overwrite is authorized by this review.
Full-project and other-PC completeness remain outside this bounded review and unproven.
